issue.positionEn: Look at the distance between objects, viewers and listeners to see what a change of setting makes possible.
issue.introEn: A design fair puts clothes beside furniture in Hong Kong. In London, models reward close listening. Two scores find time away from their films on a single record. Today’s edition follows where things are placed and what a different distance lets us notice.
issue.closingEn: Pick one object you would like to see again and follow it back through its image and sources.
